issue.title: [GraalVM for JDK 26] Version parsing fails with java.lang.ExceptionInInitializerError

repository.name: mandrel-integration-tests
repository.description: Integration tests for GraalVM and its Mandrel distribution. Runs Quarkus, Helidon and Micronaut applications and small targeted reproducers. The focus is solely on native-image utility and compilation of Java applications into native executables.

issue.body:
We see Mandrel IT failures on latest GraalVM CE for JDK 26 builds. Example:

```
[INFO] Running org.graalvm.tests.integration.JFRTest
2025-06-16 11:36:56.978 INFO  [o.g.t.i.u.v.UsedVersion$MVersion] (runNativeImageVersion) Running command [native-image, --version] to determine Mandrel version used.
[ERROR] Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 1, Skipped: 0, Time elapsed: 0.248 s <<< FAILURE! - in org.graalvm.tests.integration.JFRTest
[ERROR] jfrOptionsSmokeTest{TestInfo}  Time elapsed: 0.002 s  <<< ERROR!
java.lang.ExceptionInInitializerError
Caused by: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "String.toLowerCase()" because "version" is null

[INFO] 
[INFO] Results:
[INFO] 
[ERROR] Errors: 
[ERROR]   JFRTest.jfrOptionsSmokeTest » ExceptionInInitializer
[INFO] 
[ERROR] Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 1, Skipped: 0
[INFO] 
[INFO] ------------------------------------------------------------------------
[INFO] Reactor Summary for Native image integration TS 1.0.0-SNAPSHOT:
[INFO] 
[INFO] Native image integration TS ........................ SUCCESS [  0.070 s]
[INFO] testsuite .......................................... FAILURE [  2.475 s]
[INFO] ------------------------------------------------------------------------
[INFO] BUILD FAILURE
[INFO] ------------------------------------------------------------------------
[INFO] Total time:  2.588 s
[INFO] Finished at: 2025-06-16T11:36:57+02:00
[INFO] ------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

`native-image --version` for this build looks like this:
```
$ native-image --version
native-image 26 2026-03-17
GraalVM Runtime Environment GraalVM CE 26-dev+1.1 (build 26+1-jvmci-b01)
Substrate VM GraalVM CE 26-dev+1.1 (build 26+1, serial gc)
```

See: https://github.com/graalvm/mandrel/actions/runs/15646482173/job/44085716101#step:11:2259

body: I'll be working on a fix for this.

Yes, but there is an issue with the JDK version that this uses. It [hard-codes](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/14fca6bc3f27a57933a6c834898659d392759ef6/core/runtime/src/main/java/io/quarkus/runtime/graal/GraalVM.java#L107) `21`, while for JDK 22+ builds this is wrong. I see some integration test failures with this fixed (I need to re-test, though).

issue.title: Fix GraalVM version parsing for JDK 26-based builds
issue.body:
JDK 26+ based GraalVM builds won't have a version mapping any more. They use the JDK version scheme instead. This also fixes an issue with wrong JDK versions being detected with `io.quarkus.runtime.graal.GraalVM.Version.getCurrent()` API and adds tests for it.

**Testing**
- [x] Ran various native integration tests with various Mandrel/GraalVM builds (including JDK 26). All pass.
- [x] Unit tests in `GraalVMTest.java`

- Closes: #48403

body:
> I see some integration test failures with this fixed (I need to re-test, though).

Fresh testing today showed no issues. PR is up.
